    fields = []
    cur = []
    in_quotes = False
    field_started = False
    i = 0
    n = len(line)

    while i < n:
        c = line[i]

        if in_quotes:
            if c == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and line[i + 1] == '"':
                    cur.append('"')
                    i += 2
                    continue
                in_quotes = False
                i += 1
                continue
            cur.append(c)
            i += 1
            continue

        if c == '"' and not field_started:
            in_quotes = True
            field_started = True
            i += 1
            continue

        if c == ',':
            fields.append(''.join(cur))
            cur = []
            field_started = False
            i += 1
            continue

        cur.append(c)
        field_started = True
        i += 1

    fields.append(''.join(cur))
    return fields
